_doc: Casita dressing for tools/realsim/usd_scene.py. MEASURED: lamp xy (back-projected saturated blobs, final_poses.py), carpet/wall chroma ratios (median linear colours of model-classified pixels in mast frames). ASSUMED: absolute albedos, lamp power/kelvin, furniture placement (eyeballed from mast frames), batten pitch. Futon/glider/table/rug/door/counter blockout and drapes ported from the Cycles prototype (placed there by floor back-projection of pose-A pixels).

carpet._src: ambientCG Carpet011 recoloured beige, 4x4 re-tiled with baked ridges (carpet_ridges.py)
carpet._tint_src: matched: real carpet/wall median ratio and chroma (colour_match.py)
